ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: good hosts
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: Travellers know the colony as a place that takes people in: camps welcomed on its land and seen off on good terms, guests fed and given a bed, the hungry and the hurt seen to.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: Camps have come and gone on the colony's land and left on good terms, guests have been fed and seen safely on their way, and the road has noticed. Travellers have started to call the colony good hosts, and to plan their journeys around it.\n\nCamps will come a little sooner after one another now, and those who have lived here a while will mind a door shut on strangers.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: The road has gone quiet, and travellers no longer speak of the colony as a place to stop.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: devout
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: The colony keeps its ideoligion in the open: its rituals are held and finished, someone sits in the chaplain's seat or guides the faithful, and the old words are said when they should be.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: The colony's rituals have been kept one after another, seen through to the last word, and the faith has someone to speak for it. Word has spread that this is a devout place.\n\nPilgrims and processions will seek it out, and those who have lived here a while will mind an answer that sets the old ways aside.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: The rituals have lapsed, and people no longer speak of the colony as devout.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: long-memoried
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: The colony keeps its days: the founding, its dead, its battles and its feasts come round every year, and every year they are kept.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: Year after year the colony has kept its days: the fire lit on the founding day, the names read out for the dead, the feast after the harvest. The neighbors have started to call it long-memoried, half in respect and half as a warning.\n\nPlayers and mourners will come its way more often, and those who have lived here a while will mind an answer that lets the old ways go.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: Too many of the colony's days have been let pass, and people no longer say it remembers.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: famed for its hall
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: Travellers who stood in the colony's great room went away talking about it: the size of it, the lamps, the carpets, the room to breathe. People now come to see it.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: Visitor after visitor has stood in the colony's great room and said so to the next town. The colony is known for its hall now, and tourists, players and guests of note will come its way more often to see it.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: Nobody has remarked on the colony's hall in a long while, and the road has stopped talking about it.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: artful
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: Travellers stop in front of the colony's carvings and statues and talk about them for a season after. The colony is known for its art.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: The colony's statues and carvings have been talked about in enough towns that people now come to look at them. The colony is known as artful: tourists, famous visitors and scholars will come its way more often.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: The colony's art has gone unremarked for a long while, and the road no longer speaks of it.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: keepers of the dead
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: Travellers who pass the colony's graves see them tended and marked, and say so. The colony is known as a place that keeps its dead well.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: Travellers have carried word of the colony's graves, tended and marked, to their own towns. The colony is known as keepers of the dead: pilgrims and mourners will come its way more often, and those who have lived here a while will mind the dead being slighted.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: Nobody has spoken of the colony's graves for a long while.

ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.label: walled
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.description: Travellers who come through the colony's gate remark on its walls and turrets, and tell others. The colony is known as a hard place to walk into.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.earned: Word of the colony's walls and turrets has gone round the region. The colony is known as walled: travellers who want a safe night will come its way more often, and some who meant to rob it will think twice.
ColonyCouncil.ColonyTraitDef.lost: The road has stopped talking about the colony's walls.
